title: Advanced AI Techniques for Everyday Work
description: Advanced techniques to write clearer prompts and get more accurate AI responses.
instructorBio: Ranbeer Makin is passionate about helping working professionals confidently adopt AI. He has already trained 250+ learners through hands-on workshops and practical courses. As a software entrepreneur with 18+ years of experience, he now focuses on helping professionals move from AI Curious to AI Capable by teaching practical workflows, automation, and real-world AI applications.

items.title: Advanced AI Techniques for Everyday Work

faqs.question: What is this course?
faqs.answer: A short recorded course on writing clearer prompts. Lessons cover reflection, neutral framing, organizing your prompts, and Ram Baan.

faqs.question: How long is it?
faqs.answer: The course is about 7 minutes: 4 videos plus a quiz.

faqs.question: Do I need coding experience?
faqs.answer: No. The lessons are about prompting technique, not building software.
